sentences.text:
The petitioners have prayed for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondent-Authorities to ensure compliance of Government Order dated 12.05.2016 and pay compensation to them under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabiliation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and to pass a speaking order on their representation dated 12.3.2018.
2.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabiliation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case of the petitioners is that the respondents had utilized their land for public purpose without any formal acquisition or payment of compensation.
The claim of the petitioners is pending consideration before the Committee constituted under Government Order dated 12.5.2016.
However, no compensation amount has been paid to them so far.

sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel appearing for the State-respondents and Sri Arun Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur Nagar admits that no final decision has been taken by the Committee in the matter so far.

4.
